    Universe-independent finite category deletion #

    The category algebra used by the primitive-deletion theorem is formed after reindexing a finite object type by Fin n. This keeps its objects small without changing any Hom space. The induced base equivalence transports finite-dimensional module skeletons and their Auslander--Reiten surplus, so the checked finite deletion theorem applies to a finite category in an arbitrary object universe.
